title: Locke's Simplified Spears
description: A set of simple spear models for the new spears that sticks very close to vanilla.
body:
Locke's Simplified Spears tries to keep very close to the vanilla feel of the game while changing the models for the spears. It is perfect for casual minecrafters as it does not to detract from survival gameplay.



Each spear type shares the same model for consistency, and textures to match close to the vanilla look. As well as displaying their full size in item frames, making it pleasant to decorate with.
![Item Frame Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14bc8888325356a78b2a09d9351b7b5afd4aceb4.png)
Akin to the original Locke's Spears, I made this because I did not like the recently added spear textures. Many have the same sentiment, but felt Locke's Spears strayed too much from vanilla for them to use it for regular gameplay.
